entries.text: For wealth -In all labor there is profit.

text.text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

entries.text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; but he that gathers by labor shall increase.

text.text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

entries.text: To reduce crime - Let him who stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands.

text.text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

entries.text: To satisfy hunger - A person who labors, labors for himself, for his hunger urges him on.

text.text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

entries.text: An idle man shall suffer hunger.

text.text: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.text: In the sweat of thy face shall you eat bread.

text.text: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

entries.text: All the labor of man is for his mouth.

text.text: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

entries.text: To prevent poverty - He becomes poor that deals with a slack hand; but the hand of the diligent makes one rich.

text.text: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

entries.text: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty.

text.text: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

entries.text: For life - the labor of the righteous leads to life.

text.text: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

entries.text: To cause productivity rather than waste - He who is slack in his work is brother to him who destroys.

text.text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

entries.text: A man who is diligent in his business will stand before kings, and not the lowly.

text.text: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

entries.text: To have a peaceful life - The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.

text.text: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
